Implemented the CLI in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with the build config in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). The binary builds as `iges` with:

```sh
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I also ran a basic end-to-end sanity check on a minimal Type 110 line entity: `write`, `parse`, `eval`, and `roundtrip` all succeeded, and the round-tripped IGES file was byte-identical on the second pass for that case.

Residual risk: this is a substantial implementation and I only had time to sanity-check a small representative file, not exhaustively validate every entity path against the full IGES 5.3 corpus.
